title: Add `podman artifact exists` command
body:
### Feature request description

Our other command suites have `exists` commands to easily check if a given object exists (e.g. `podman container exists`). We don't have that for artifacts.

### Suggest potential solution

Add a new command, `podman artifact exists`. Returns 0 if an artifact with the given name or digest exists, 1 otherwise.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

Could just use `artifact list --filter` but that's much less elegant

### Additional context

N/A
